svg.title: Expertise: build to last, make delivery dependable, help the team move forward
svg.desc: Build to last. Is each new feature getting harder to ship? I help clarify responsibilities, manage state and prioritise technical debt so the app can evolve. Make delivery dependable. Are releases taking too much effort? I automate delivery, test critical journeys and improve production monitoring, from pull request to the stores. Help the team move forward. Does the team need technical direction? I help weigh architecture choices, review code and share knowledge through day-to-day collaboration.
